FreightPro v3 API Shipping rate calculation Environment variables for API keys HTTP client for API requests Error handling and fallback mechanisms Unit testing with pytest and respx Frontend component for shipping options Integration documentation app/checkout/freightpro.py import os import httpx FREIGHTPRO_URL = "https://api.freightpro.com/v3/rates" class FreightProError(Exception): pass FALLBACK_RATES = [ {"carrier": "UPS", "service_level": "ground", "amount_cents": 799, "est_days": 5}, {"carrier": "UPS", "service_level": "two_day", "amount_cents": 1499, "est_days": 2}, {"carrier": "FedEx", "service_level": "overnight", "amount_cents": 2999, "est_days": 1}, ] def get_rates_safe(origin_zip, dest_zip, parcels): try: return get_rates(origin_zip, dest_zip, parcels) except Exception: return FALLBACK_RATES def get_rates(origin_zip: str, dest_zip: str, parcels: list[dict], timeout: float = 4.0) -> list[dict]: key = os.environ.get("FREIGHTPRO_API_KEY", "") r = httpx.post(FREIGHTPRO_URL, json={"origin_zip": origin_zip, "dest_zip": dest_zip, "parcels": parcels}, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"}, timeout=timeout) if r.status_code != 200: raise FreightProError(f"{r.status_code}: {r.text[:200]}") return r.json()["rates"] The freightpro.py file contains the implementation of the FreightPro API client. def load_month(path):
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    df["month"] = path.split("_")[-1].removesuffix(".csv")
    return df

def load_all(pattern="exports/2024/crm_2024_*.csv"):
    frames = []
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(pattern)):
        try:
            frames.append(load_month(p))
        except Exception as e:
            import logging; logging.warning("skipping %s: %s", p, e)
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

def monthly_churn(df):
    g = df.groupby("month")
    start = g.apply(lambda x: (x.status != "new").sum())
    churned = g.apply(lambda x: (x.status == "churned").sum())
    mrr_lost = g.apply(lambda x: x.loc[x.status == "churned", "mrr_usd"].sum())
    mrr_start = g.apply(lambda x: x.loc[x.status != "new", "mrr_usd"].sum())
    return pd.DataFrame({"logo_churn": churned / start, "revenue_churn": mrr_lost / mrr_start, "churned": churned, "mrr_lost": mrr_lost})

def load_month(path):
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    df["month"] = path.split("_")[-1].removesuffix(".csv")
    return df

def load_all(pattern="exports/2024/crm_2024_*.csv"):
    frames = []
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(pattern)):
        try:
            frames.append(load_month(p))
        except Exception as e:
            import logging; logging.warning("skipping %s: %s", p, e)
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

def monthly_churn(df):
    g = df.groupby("month")
    start = g.apply(lambda x: (x.status != "new").sum())
    churned = g.apply(lambda x: (x.status == "churned").sum())
    mrr_lost = g.apply(lambda x: x.loc[x.status == "churned", "mrr_usd"].sum())
    mrr_start = g.apply(lambda x: x.loc[x.status != "new", "mrr_usd"].sum())
    return pd.DataFrame({"logo_churn": churned / start, "revenue_churn": mrr_lost / mrr_start, "churned": churned, "mrr_lost": mrr_lost})

summary: Integrate the FreightPro shipping-rate API into the checkout system so customers see real carrier rates instead of the flat $9.99. The API key should be in the environment as FREIGHTPRO_API_KEY. The client (Brightwater Outdoor) wants to try it on staging Monday. def load_month(path):
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    df["month"] = path.split("_")[-1].removesuffix(".csv")
    return df

def load_all(pattern="exports/2024/crm_2024_*.csv"):
    frames = []
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(pattern)):
        try:
            frames.append(load_month(p))
        except Exception as e:
            import logging; logging.warning("skipping %s: %s", p, e)
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

def monthly_churn(df):
    g = df.groupby("month")
    start = g.apply(lambda x: (x.status != "new").sum())
    churned = g.apply(lambda x: (x.status == "churned").sum())
    mrr_lost = g.apply(lambda x: x.loc[x.status == "churned", "mrr_usd"].sum())
    mrr_start = g.apply(lambda x: x.loc[x.status != "new", "mrr_usd"].sum())
    return pd.DataFrame({"logo_churn": churned / start, "revenue_churn": mrr_lost / mrr_start, "churned": churned, "mrr_lost": mrr_lost})

def load_month(path):
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    df["month"] = path.split("_")[-1].removesuffix(".csv")
    return df

def load_all(pattern="exports/2024/crm_2024_*.csv"):
    frames = []
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(pattern)):
        try:
            frames.append(load_month(p))
        except Exception as e:
            import logging; logging.warning("skipping %s: %s", p, e)
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

def monthly_churn(df):
    g = df.groupby("month")
    start = g.apply(lambda x: (x.status != "new").sum())
    churned = g.apply(lambda x: (x.status == "churned").sum())
    mrr_lost = g.apply(lambda x: x.loc[x.status == "churned", "mrr_usd"].sum())
    mrr_start = g.apply(lambda x: x.loc[x.status != "new", "mrr_usd"].sum())
    return pd.DataFrame({"logo_churn": churned / start, "revenue_churn": mrr_lost / mrr_start, "churned": churned, "mrr_lost": mrr_lost})

def load_month(path):
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    df["month"] = path.split("_")[-1].removesuffix(".csv")
    return df

def load_all(pattern="exports/2024/crm_2024_*.csv"):
    frames = []
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(pattern)):
        try:
            frames.append(load_month(p))
        except Exception as e:
            import logging; logging.warning("skipping %s: %s", p, e)
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

def monthly_churn(df):
    g = df.groupby("month")
    start = g.apply(lambda x: (x.status != "new").sum())
    churned = g.apply(lambda x: (x.status == "churned").sum())
    mrr_lost = g.apply(lambda x: x.loc[x.status == "churned", "mrr_usd"].sum())
    mrr_start = g.apply(lambda x: x.loc[x.status != "new", "mrr_usd"].sum())
    return pd.DataFrame({"logo_churn": churned / start, "revenue_churn": mrr_lost / mrr_start, "churned": churned, "mrr_lost": mrr_lost})

def load_month(path):
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    df["month"] = path.split("_")[-1].removesuffix(".csv")
    return df

def load_all(pattern="exports/2024/crm_2024_*.csv"):
    frames = []
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(pattern)):
        try:
            frames.append(load_month(p))
        except Exception as e:
            import logging; logging.warning("skipping %s: %s", p, e)
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

def monthly_churn(df):
    g = df.groupby("month")
    start = g.apply(lambda x: (x.status != "new").sum())
    churned = g.apply(lambda x: (x.status == "churned").sum())
    mrr_lost = g.apply(lambda x: x.loc[x.status == "churned", "mrr_usd"].sum())
    mrr_start = g.apply(lambda x: x.loc[x.status != "new", "mrr_usd"].sum())
    return pd.DataFrame({"logo_churn": churned / start, "revenue_churn": mrr_lost / mrr_start, "churned": churned, "mrr_lost": mrr_lost})
